gaps.sentence: Not since the winter of 1963 ___ temperatures dropped so low.
gaps.explanation: 'Not since 1963 have temperatures dropped …' — the only time from then until now.

gaps.sentence: So rapid ___ the spread of the fire that the building was lost.
gaps.explanation: 'So rapid was the spread that …' — fronted 'so + adj' with inversion.

gaps.sentence: ___ you require assistance, please do not hesitate to contact the desk.
gaps.explanation: 'Should you require …' = 'If you should require …' — formal inverted conditional.

gaps.sentence: Only later ___ it occur to her that the letter had been a forgery.
gaps.explanation: 'Only later' at the front inverts with do-support: did it occur to her.

gaps.sentence: Only when the results were published ___ the scale of the error become clear.
gaps.explanation: 'Only when … did the scale … become clear' — inverted past simple.

gaps.sentence: ___ the storm passed did the ferries resume service.
gaps.explanation: Only after/once the storm passed did… — fronted 'only' phrase.

gaps.sentence: To such extremes ___ the fans go that the police were called in.
gaps.explanation: 'To such extremes did the fans go that …' — inverted past simple.

gaps.sentence: ___ I known about the deadline, I would have hurried.
gaps.explanation: Had I known = If I had known — inversion replaces 'if'.
